takes place at the bottom of the sea, on the seabed, giving it a blue tint. The underwater bed of sand is layered on by tall rocks and sandy dunes. There are a few naval mines dotted around the map. Some of the rocks form arches. There is an activity of life on the map including seaweed and coral. There is also a deep trench, where there appears to be a giant octopus lurking beneath the surface. Dolphins can also be seen in the trench, swimming in the water. Various shipwrecks and underwater mines can be seen on this map. A mermaid statue holding a trident can also be seen.

The path begins at the haunted shipwrecked ship. The path is initially a wooden bridge before transforming into a sandy path. It goes across the sand dunes, underneath a rocky arch. It then crosses a stone bridge over the trench where it reaches the other dune. It then ends at an underwater cave.

The majority of the turns on this map takes place near the arch. Most ground towers should be located there.
Therefore, ground towers should be placed on the first dune, where the path goes underneath the rocky arch.
Cliff towers can be placed on the arch, meaning it is quite a valuable spot. They can also be placed on several mounds.
